pretreatment: H2SO4 boiling, HF dipping, and UV ozone cleaning
evidence: Boron-doped, 8 ×35 mm² rectangular-shaped Si(100) substrates whose resistivity ranged from 100 to 200 Ω·cm were utilized. Before being introduced to the process chamber, each sample was chemically cleaned using H2SO4 boiling, HF dipping, and UV ozone cleaning.
